name: Williamsburg city, VA
findings: Williamsburg city has 211 nonprofit organizations. 94 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 76 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Williamsburg city has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Williamsburg city list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 76 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
